en.meta_title: Lip Fillers & Reshaping: Natural-Looking Lip Augmentation
en.meta_description: Enhance your lips with our expert lip reshaping and augmentation services. Using premium dermal fillers, we can add volume, define borders, and create a beautiful, balanced pout that is perfectly proportioned to your face.
en.meta_keywords: lip fillers, lip reshaping, lip augmentation, dermal fillers, fuller lips, cosmetic injections, lip enhancement

what_is.heading: What is Lip Reshaping? More Than Just Volume
paragraphs: Perfect your pout with our custom Lip Reshaping and augmentation services. More than just adding volume, our expert injectors use premium hyaluronic acid fillers as an artistic tool to enhance your natural beauty. We focus on creating beautiful, balanced results that are perfectly proportioned to your face.

applications.heading: Customized Lip Enhancements
paragraphs: Our lip filler treatments can be used to achieve a variety of goals: add subtle or significant volume, define the vermillion border (the edge of the lips), enhance the Cupid's bow, correct asymmetry, and smooth out vertical lip lines (smoker's lines).

procedure.heading: A Quick Procedure with Immediate Results
paragraphs: At LUNAI, we prioritize a natural look and feel. The procedure is performed using a topical anesthetic for your comfort and typically takes about 30 minutes. Results are immediate, though there may be some initial swelling. The final, beautifully enhanced lips can be enjoyed for 6 to 12 months.
